segments.text: Fourteen hundred years ago, one book issued a challenge to the entire human race. Produce a single chapter like this one. Its shortest chapter is only ten words long. And that challenge has stood, unanswered, ever since.
segments._shot: a single spotlight on darkness, empty stage of light

segments.text: This... is the challenge of the Qur'an.
segments.title: THE CHALLENGE

segments.text: First, some background. The Qur'an is the book Muslims believe Allah, the Creator, revealed to the Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him. It came in Arabic, to a people who prized their language above everything else. To them, poetry was news, honor, and power all at once. They were masters of the spoken word.
segments._shot: desert campfire sparks rising into night

segments.text: And to those masters, it said this. If you are in doubt about what We sent down to Our servant, then bring one chapter like it. And call on any helper you have besides Allah, if you are truthful.

Then the next verse does what no careful author ever would. It promises the outcome in advance, for all time. If you cannot do it, and you never will, then beware the Fire. A challenge with a prophecy built inside it.
segments._shot: vast night sky over silhouetted dunes

segments.text: And the bar is low. The shortest chapter in the Qur'an, al-Kawthar, is only ten words. Ten words, against every poet, every scholar, and every century since.
segments._shot: ten small lights igniting one by one in darkness

segments.text: The people with the most reason to try were those same masters of Arabic, the ones who fought the Prophet, peace be upon him, with armies. Yet they never answered it with ten words of their own. Fourteen centuries later, the silence still stands.
segments._shot: still, empty desert at dusk, wind only

segments.text: A challenge this old, this small, and this public, still unanswered, leaves you with one question. Read those ten words tonight... and ask where they came from.
segments._shot: soft light growing over a horizon at dawn
